verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only manual exports of the cap table from the reports UI, including Excel reports and an Open Cap Table Format (OCF) export, plus inbound HRIS integrations. Nothing documents a programmatic API for pulling stakeholders, share classes, securities or vesting states, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. A file export is not the documented API the story requires, so the axis applies but is not delivered.
